title: Tween Sprite3D colors in SubViewport with Transparent background results jittering
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible Godot v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 22000) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3713) - AMD Ryzen 7 2700 Eight-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

The Transparent BG setting on SubViewport makes the color transition on Sprite3D/MeshInstance3D jittering on both Tween and _process()

**NOTE: This only happens in Mobile Renderer**, it took me 3 days to realize this and I switched to Compability since my project aims for Mobile & PC.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe0fd66b-c8ad-4a51-8311-180650243ece

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create New Project > Select Mobile Renderer
2. Create nodes: Control > SubViewportContainer > SubViewport > Sprite3D (Or MeshInstance3D) > Camera3D
3. Add script to tween/transition Sprite3D color and turn on SubViewport > Viewport > Transparent BG via Inspector
4. Play the scene

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20035579/new-game-project.zip)
